configuration.off_center_selection: Nearest lattice depths round(k*delta/h), k=1,2,3; plus ceil(delta/h), ceil(2*delta/h) to test asymmetric closed one/two-hop stencils; reflected pairs.
configuration.center_cancellation_caveat: A zero center force does not establish translation-invariant coefficients or minimum sufficient graph closure.

oracle.offset_inclusion: 0 < norm(offset*h) <= delta; radial quadratic has rho<1 support

closure.definition: D0={i}; Dq=union of family neighbors of D(q-1). Sets overlap; counts are not disjoint shells. Required sets use the infinite lattice.
closure.required_volumes: Every required D0..D3 node must have h^3, not boundary quadrature weights.

coefficients.scope: omega0 and K: D0 union D1 union D2 (K includes Fbar reconstruction); Z: D0 union D1; K_direct_B separately restricts K to D0 union D1; wbar: all bonds incident to D0 union D1. Matrix errors are relative Frobenius norms.
